description: Plans board and batten, wainscoting or picture frame molding on one wall: spacing, the cut list (miter long and short points for frames) and how many boards of each retail length to buy, with the total length bought and offcut percentage for each stock length; the length to buy is the one that buys the least total length, then the least offcut, then the fewest boards. The cut plan is first-fit decreasing: feasible, not proven optimal. Lengths accept feet and inches. Returns a link to the full plan on calculiva.com.

baseboardHeight.description: Existing baseboard height; "0" if none. Default 5 1/4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

battenCount.description: board-and-batten: number of battens. Omit to use battenSpacing.

battenSpacing.description: board-and-batten: target gap between battens, used when battenCount is omitted. Default 12 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

battenWidth.description: board-and-batten: actual batten width (a 1x3 is 2 1/2 in). Default 2 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

bottomRailWidth.description: wainscoting stile-and-rail: bottom rail width. Default 5 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

capHeight.description: picture-frame-molding: height of the underside of the chair rail. Default 36 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

chairRailWidth.description: wainscoting: chair rail height (board width). Default 2 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

edge.description: board-and-batten: start and end the wall with a space (default) or with a batten.

edgeBottom.description: picture-frame-molding: bottom margin. Default 4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

edgeTop.description: picture-frame-molding: top margin. Default 4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

edgeX.description: picture-frame-molding: side margin. Default 4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

extraPercent.description: Extra boards to buy, % of the boards in the cut plan. Default 10.

fullHeight.description: board-and-batten: battens run to the ceiling. Default false.

gapX.description: picture-frame-molding: gap between boxes. Default 4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

gapY.description: picture-frame-molding: gap between rows. Default 4 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

hasCap.description: picture-frame-molding: a chair rail caps the boxes (default true); false = boxes run to the ceiling.

kerf.description: Saw kerf, charged between two cuts on the same board. Default 1/8 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

layout.description: board-and-batten: vertical battens (default) or a grid with horizontal rails.

memberWidth.description: wainscoting: stile width, or side reveal between frames. Default 3 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

moldingWidth.description: wainscoting applied-frames (default 1 1/4 in) or picture-frame-molding (default 1 in): molding face width. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

openings.description: Up to 4 openings or obstacles on the wall; pieces that land on them are flagged and left out of the cut list.

label.description: Name shown in the plan, e.g. "window"

position.description: Distance from the left end of the wall to the left edge of the opening or obstacle. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

width.description: Width of the opening or obstacle (window, door, outlet, switch). Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

panelCount.description: wainscoting: number of panels or frames. Omit to use panelWidth.

panelWidth.description: wainscoting: target panel width, used when panelCount is omitted. Default 30 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

project.description: board-and-batten, wainscoting (applied frames or stile and rail) or picture-frame-molding (boxes of 45° mitered molding).

railCount.description: board-and-batten grid: horizontal rails per bay. Default 2.

revealVertical.description: wainscoting applied-frames: reveal above and below each frame. Default 3 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

stockLengthsFt.description: Board lengths you can buy, in feet (1 to 8 values, each up to 24). Default: 8, 10, 12 and 16 ft are compared and any of them can be recommended; pass the lengths your store sells to plan on those.

style.description: wainscoting: applied molding frames (default) or stiles and rails.

topRailHeight.description: board-and-batten: height of the top of the top rail from the floor. Default 32 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

topRailWidth.description: board-and-batten top rail, or wainscoting stile-and-rail top rail width. Default 3 1/2 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

wainscotHeight.description: wainscoting: overall height from the floor, chair rail included. Default 32 in. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

wallHeight.description: Wall height, floor to ceiling. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

wallWidth.description: Wall width. Length with its unit, e.g. "12 ft 6 in", "12'6\"", "150 in", "3m80"; a bare number is read as inches.

name: plan_trim_order

buy.description: Boards to buy: the best stock length by comparisonRule; null when no length holds the longest piece.

comparisonRule.description: The ranking used for every "better" statement in this result; a tie recommends nothing.

title: Plan a trim board order
